The '''Sarapin system''' was home to the planets [[Sarapin/Legends|Sarapin]], [[Sarapin Four]], Sarapin's moons and defensive grid, and at least one star. The system produced the majority of power for the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] government. Its primary star was [[Sarapin Prime]].
